primitives.name: Intent settlement pallet
primitives.desc: Intent settlement on Materios: requests reserve a positive runtime-minimum bond in a named Balances reserve; slash tombstones are request-scoped, and an M-of-N committee supersede settles claims that unslashable junk would block. Expired requests refund with explicit deficit events, fresh genesis closes legacy paths, FRV2 binds each fraud allegation to its request, and every digest tag is a metadata constant. Bundles are scanned before verification, bond paths carry measured weights, and try-runtime checks versions, cutovers and bond backing.

primitives.name: Intent-settlement oracle pallet
primitives.desc: Threshold price oracle publishing attested median prices, with staleness and deviation guards.

primitives.name: Committee governance pallet
primitives.desc: Governance over the settlement committee: membership, thresholds and parameter changes under a root-gated origin.

primitives.name: Settlement keeper
primitives.desc: Off-chain keeper that turns voucher batches into Cardano payout transactions, waits for confirmation and settles them on Materios from chain state: it files bonded requests, attests or supersedes blocking requests, marks claims settled only when the chain does, and releases its bonds.

primitives.name: Intent settlement SDK
primitives.desc: TypeScript client for building, signing and submitting settlement intents; rejects extrinsics whose dispatch failed and reads settlement requests, attested bonds and runtime constants.
